Bram called my weapon "serviceable". I am still thinking about it.
Hall.
Right. Coffee, then monsters.
Sela quoted me for a ring and I laughed. She did not.
Spent half the morning reading the Hall of Fame. No regrets.
There is a door under the Tankard and I do not like it.
Somebody has taken my usual seat at the Tankard and I am being very calm about it.
Madame Vesna told me my fortune. It was mostly about money I do not have.
The banner needs washing.
Something in the Menagerie has learned to open its latch.
Marla has changed the ale and is pretending she has not.
Evening. Anyone still up?
Nobody awake but me and the lanterns.
Quiet in here today.
Back. Missed anything?
